rules.v: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
rules.vi: Instrumen khusus dengan hak lebih sempit, atau hanya pasal tertentu dari hukum umum
rules.n: Domestic workers are outside the Labour Law but covered by a dedicated regulation with fines (OMR 50-500 per violation, multiplied by the number of workers); it repeals MR 189/2004.

rules.f: Written contract in a language understood
rules.fi: Kontrak tertulis dalam bahasa yang dipahami
rules.v: Written contract required, no language rule
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis wajib, tanpa aturan bahasa
rules.n: Written contract in Arabic, registered online with the ministry.
The minimum wage does not apply to migrant workers.

rules.v: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
rules.vi: Pembayaran minimal bulanan, terdokumentasi, dengan batas potongan atau upah natura
rules.n: Paid in Omani rials within seven days of the due date, proved by a signed register or a local bank account; the ministry may set a payment system; deductions capped at 25 per cent.

rules.v: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
rules.vi: Hanya aturan istirahat harian, atau batas lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: Up to 12 hours a day with at least 8 hours' rest; up to 2 hours' paid overtime by written agreement. Longer than the 8-hour norm for other workers.

rules.v: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
rules.vi: Minimal 24 jam berturut-turut, tidak dapat diganti uang atas permintaan pemberi kerja
rules.n: At least one paid rest day a week; work on that day only with written consent and extra pay or a substitute day.

rules.v: Equal to or longer than for other workers
rules.vi: Sama atau lebih panjang dari pekerja lain
rules.n: At least 21 days' paid annual leave; untaken leave paid out at the end of service.

rules.f: Keeping own identity and travel documents
rules.fi: Memegang dokumen identitas dan perjalanan sendiri
rules.v: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
rules.vi: Hanya aturan umum, tidak khusus pekerja rumah tangga atau tanpa sanksi
rules.n: The employer may not keep the passport or documents except with the worker's written consent.

rules.v: Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
rules.vi: Pekerja boleh memilih tinggal di luar; akomodasi di rumah harus layak dan privat
rules.n: Food and suitable housing: a ventilated, lit and air-conditioned room with a bed, wardrobe and proper toilet; free transport for workers living out.

rules.v: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
rules.vi: Pindah hanya dalam keadaan tertentu atau setelah syarat terpenuhi
rules.n: No unilateral right to change employer: transfer by agreement only. The worker may leave without notice, keeping all rights, if wages are unpaid for over two months or in cases of fraud, assault or serious danger.

rules.v: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
rules.vi: Pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya rekrutmen
rules.n: The employer may not take any money from the worker for recruitment, employment or transfer; agency fees are barred by the 2011 agency rules.
Licensed recruitment offices; the office may notify the ministry on the worker's behalf.

rules.vi: Hanya berdasarkan pengaduan atau pengawasan agen
rules.n: Ministry inspectors may interview the worker and request documents; a home visit needs the Public Prosecution's permission.

rules.v: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
rules.vi: Pengadilan atau tribunal ketenagakerjaan setara pekerja lain, atau tanpa biaya
rules.n: Labour Law dispute procedure applies; the worker pays no court fees at any stage.
rules.s: MD 574/2025 Reg. art. 37; Royal Decree 53/2023 art. 9

rules.v: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
rules.vi: Sebagian: hanya perawatan medis, kecelakaan kerja atau asuransi pemberi kerja
rules.n: Up to 30 days' paid sick leave a year; health insurance; end-of-service pay of half a month's wage a year after two years' service (counted from the regulation's entry into force); maternity not provided.

rules.f: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
rules.v: General criminal or civil law only
rules.vi: Hanya hukum pidana atau perdata umum
rules.n: Forced labour and violence banned; degrading advertising of workers banned; the worker may leave after assault.

rules.vi: Tidak ada hak yang diakui hukum
rules.n: The regulation has no provision on association; Labour Law union rights do not extend to domestic workers.

decisions.nm: Al Sawadi Resort workers’ wage claims
decisions.pe: A resort in Oman closed and 73 workers were left stranded without wages. Most of them won their court cases for unpaid pay.
decisions.pi: Sebuah resor di Oman tutup dan 73 pekerja terlantar tanpa upah. Sebagian besar memenangkan perkara mereka di pengadilan atas upah yang belum dibayar.

help.de: Government ministry that receives labor complaints, including from domestic workers under Ministerial Decision 574/2025. Unresolved disputes go to the courts.
help.di: Kementerian yang menerima pengaduan ketenagakerjaan, termasuk dari pekerja rumah tangga berdasarkan Keputusan Menteri 574/2025. Sengketa yang tidak selesai dibawa ke pengadilan.
